options.reason: The table was evidently assembled to relate protein abundance to HER2 status: it has one binary label (0/1, 107 vs 15) plus 12k protein-abundance features, and sample_id is a row key. The task is therefore binary classification of HER2 status from the proteome, with stratification and class weighting for the 12% positive rate, and evaluation by discrimination, calibration and decision-curve analysis. No additional column is an obvious recoding of the label; the abbreviated feature list does not expose the HER2/ERBB2 protein itself, so leakage is flagged as a check rather than asserted.
